svg.title: Kamchatka 2025 earthquake in GRACE-FO
svg.text: Is the 2025 Kamchatka earthquake visible in GRACE-FO?
COST-G monthly gravity, degree ≤ 60, 300 km Gaussian, no destriping. Step at 29 July 2025 fitted with trend, seasons and a post-event ramp.
c. Largest |step| within 500 km (µGal): Kamchatka against 100 ocean points
rank p = 0.010 (above the null's 95th percentile: detected)
